title: Classic Spells
description: Spell definitions for the classic Archaos game mode.

description.description: Player-facing description shown in the spellbook.

chance.description: Base probability (0–1) that the spell succeeds when cast.

balance.description: World-balance contribution: positive = law, negative = chaos.

unitId.description: ID of the unit created when this spell is summoned (hex or decimal string key from classicunits.json).

target.description: What the spell is targeted at.

castOnEnemyUnit.description: Whether the spell can be cast on an enemy unit.

castOnWizard.description: Whether the spell can be cast on an enemy wizard.

destroyWizardCreatures.description: Whether a successful cast also destroys all creatures owned by the target wizard.

lineOfSight.description: Whether the spell requires an unobstructed line of sight to the target.

range.description: Maximum range in tiles. -1 means unlimited (global).

projectile.description: Key identifying the projectile visual fired when this spell is cast.

damage.description: Damage dealt to the target on a successful hit.

castTimes.description: Number of times this spell can be cast in a single turn (defaults to 1 if omitted).

allowIllusion.description: Whether this spell can be cast as an illusion.

autoPlace.description: Whether the game automatically places summoned units rather than the player choosing tiles.

tree.description: Whether the summoned unit is classified as a tree (for wood-related effects).

persist.description: Whether the spell remains in the wizard's hand after being cast.

giftOnly.description: Whether this spell can only be acquired as a gift (not drawn at game start).

spellFrame.description: Override for the spell animation frame index used during casting.

types.description: Classification tags used by the AI and UI to categorise the spell.
